commit_message:
[LinalgExt] Canonicalize zero zero-points in affine QDQ ops (#24905)

Canonicalizes `iree_linalg_ext.quantize_affine` and
`iree_linalg_ext.dequantize_affine` by removing a zero-point operand
when its constant value is zero in every element. The operations then
expose symmetric quantization directly, allowing decomposition to omit
zero-point arithmetic and the integer-contraction rewrite to skip the
corresponding correction terms.

Handles scalar constants, tensor splats, dense tensors, and
resource-backed tensor constants. Removing the operand also removes its
indexing map and `zp_unsigned` attribute while preserving the remaining
operation attributes. Tests cover these constant representations,
nonzero values that must remain, and preservation of the operation's
other parameters.

Builds on #24902 in the affine QDQ stack. Part of #24862.

Signed-off-by: Thomas Ziereis <ziereis@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
fix(PackConstants): don't start new storage buffer if current one is still empty

The PackConstant pass introduces a new buffer when a constant cannot be packed
into the current buffer without exceeding the maximum size. However, if a
constant is itself larger than the limit, it gets still added, but in a
separate buffer.
This change fixes a bug in the packing logic when a constant bigger than the
limit is encountered when the current buffer is still empty. In this case,
the current buffer stayed empty and the big constant got added to a new
buffer. The empty buffer caused errors of size 0 buffers not being supported
in following passes. This change avoids adding a new buffer is the current
one is empty and thus avoids these errors.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[LinalgExt] Canonicalize zero zero-points in affine QDQ ops (#24905)

Canonicalizes `iree_linalg_ext.quantize_affine` and
`iree_linalg_ext.dequantize_affine` by removing a zero-point operand
when its constant value is zero in every element. The operations then
expose symmetric quantization directly, allowing decomposition to omit
zero-point arithmetic and the integer-contraction rewrite to skip the

commit_message:
[WASM] Add missing f64 musl builtins for ONNX operations (#24953)

LLVMCPU executable linking fails with undefined references when
generated code calls `exp`, `floor`, `log`, or `round`. This is because
their f64 implementations and dependencies are missing from IREE's
embedded musl bitcode.

Added the missing sources and dependencies to wasm32 and wasm64 musl
Makefiles and regenerated the bitcode libraries. During embedded
linking, LLVMCPU uses the generic wasm32 and wasm64 bitcode libraries to
provide C math functions to 32-bit and 64-bit targets.

Removed the twelve now-passing ONNX cases from O0 and O2
expected-compilation-failure list.

Progress on #24378.

expected-compilation-failure list.

[LinalgExt] Canonicalize zero zero-points in affine QDQ ops (#24905)

Canonicalizes `iree_linalg_ext.quantize_affine` and
`iree_linalg_ext.dequantize_affine` by removing a zero-point operand
when its constant value is zero in every element. The operations then
expose symmetric quantization directly, allowing decomposition to omit
zero-point arithmetic and the integer-contraction rewrite to skip the
corresponding correction terms.

Handles scalar constants, tensor splats, dense tensors, and
resource-backed tensor constants. Removing the operand also removes its
indexing map and `zp_unsigned` attribute while preserving the remaining
operation attributes. Tests cover these constant representations,
nonzero values that must remain, and preservation of the operation's
other parameters.

Builds on #24902 in the affine QDQ stack. Part of #24862.
